name: Xi'an Global Printing Co., Ltd.
summary: Established in 2001 and headquartered in Xi'an, China, Xi'an Global Printing Co., Ltd. delivers extensive packaging solutions to pharmaceutical companies both within China and globally. The firm supplies a variety of packaging materials, including pharmaceutical folding cartons, informational leaflets, and aluminum tubes, alongside comprehensive service strategies for these products. Its offerings are utilized across a broad spectrum of items, ranging from over-the-counter and prescription medications to health and wellness products, medical devices, traditional herbal remedies, and cosmetic goods.
